# sendio_topic (Resource)

A topic contacts can subscribe to or opt out of (shown on the unsubscribe page when public).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendio_topic" "product_news" {
  name                 = "Product news"
  description          = "New features, once a month"
  default_subscription = "opt_in"
  visibility           = "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_subscription` (String) `opt_in`: every contact gets the topic unless they opt out; `opt_out`: only contacts who opt in. It cannot be changed, so changing it creates a new topic.
- `name` (String) Topic name (at most 50 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description (at most 200 characters).
- `visibility` (String) `private` (default) or `public` (listed on the unsubscribe page).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the topic was created.
- `id` (String) Topic id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendio_topic.product_news 5b1d2c3e-4f50-4617-8293-a4b5c6d7e8f9
```
